description: This file defines the ContentPage class for the Confluence format in the Daux documentation generator. It manages content processing, embedding images, and converting HTML details tags for Confluence compatibility.

classes.name: ContentPage
classes.description: A class responsible for generating and processing Confluence format content pages, including embedding images and converting HTML elements to Confluence markup.

methods.name: generatePage
methods.description: Generates the page content, embedding images, converting details tags, and adding a Confluence info macro header if configured.

methods.name: createImageTag
methods.description: Creates an `<ac:image>` tag with appropriate attributes and included attachment filename for embedding images in Confluence.
